title: Philippians
author: Paul the apostle.
historicalSetting: Philippians encourages joy, humility, unity, perseverance, and Christ-centered living.
keyVerse: Philippians 1:21 — "For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain."
christFocus: Philippians points to Christ as the believer's life, joy, pattern of humility, and prize above all things.
